goal: 对 STS1 Karen 原始遗物图标进行保真高清修复；保留造型，不改设计。

jobs.name: 饼干
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached PNG is the actual low-resolution relic icon from the user's STS1 Karen mod. Restore and upscale THIS EXACT ICON, using it as the edit target. Its occupied pixels are small within a transparent 128x128 canvas; focus on the existing object, not the blank margins. Preserve the original silhouette, viewing angle, proportions, pose, main color blocks, markings and recognizable small details. Clean pixel stair-steps and compression-like rough edges into crisp, restrained 2D game-icon linework with the same modest shading. Do not redesign or replace it with a merchandise photo. Reconstruct unclear pixels conservatively; do not add unsupported decoration or realistic texture. Enlarge the existing object to fit about 80% of a square high-resolution canvas, with at least 8% transparent padding on every side. GENUINELY transparent background, including all internal cutouts, with clean antialiased alpha edges and no halo, floating specks or drawn checkerboard. Single isolated icon only, no labels. Aim for 1024x1024 or greater. Specific invariants: the object is the original red, slightly crumpled rectangular snack packet lying horizontally with a slight diagonal tilt. Keep its folded darker left end, muted crimson body, dark lower edge and the broad off-white printed markings in exactly the original arrangement. Treat unclear markings as the same graphic shapes, without inventing a new word or brand. No loose cookies, transparent bag, golden tie or new packaging design. Keep the original red packet only.
